x: Roy Liggins 2nd in the Javelin was a good effort, as was that of promising new member Ware in 6th place. Mal Ash only did two events, getting a 1st and 2nd, and Charlie Jones also got a double of "sorts".

Thames Valley Harriers started last year a Winter Field Events Meeting and again this year put on a similar meeting. Roy Liggins, Ted Gaworski and Percy Porter competed. Percy was 2nd in the Hammer and Ted was in the first six in the Discus.
Roy Liggins was throwing as well as ever in distance, but was having difficulty with his run-up and the strong wind, and did not get a recorded throw.
